Change Request: Add a standalone Notes section. Dropdown selects which log section the note belongs to. Notes support image upload.
Context / Rationale: Notes capture machine failures / process changes that otherwise get lost.
Acceptance Criteria: Note saved with section tag; appears in that section and on run summary; images attach to the note.

Change Request: Uploaded images: view full-size, delete, or replace with another photo.
Context / Rationale: Daniel could not remove a photo during the dummy run.
Acceptance Criteria: Image can be viewed, deleted and replaced pre-finalization; file removed from disk; locked after finalize.

Change Request: Shrink photos in the browser before upload (client-side resize/compression).
Context / Rationale: Render disk = 1 GB, stores last 3 versions of prod env. No server resizing; ~5 MB per file; JPEGs don't compress in zip backups.
Acceptance Criteria: Typical tablet photo uploads at < 500 KB; all upload inputs covered.
Notes: PR #46 merged 2026-10-19: photos are shrunk in the browser before upload (long side 1600 px, JPEG 80%). Originals are not kept - QM-001 decision C11.

Change Request: Image retention: back up images to SharePoint and purge from Render after a set age (e.g. ~1 month).
Context / Rationale: Photos of tote surface growth are useful as a catalog, but long-term value is low vs. pH/ORP data. Render storage grows with every run.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision on N days; archived images still viewable via link; Render disk usage stops growing.
Notes: Decision 2026-10-19: archive images from Render to SharePoint after 30 days, keep a link on the record. Not built yet.

Change Request: Odor and odor intensity: remove 'required' flag (make optional).
Context / Rationale: Reduce operator exposure to mold spores/VOCs. Transcript says both 'remove required' and 'remove fields'. Confirm intent.
Acceptance Criteria: Run finalizes with odor fields blank; historical data intact.
Notes: PR #48 merged 2026-10-19: feedstock odour and odour intensity are optional (fields and history kept). QM-001 decision C10 (requirement change).

Change Request: Optional odor observation at final check on pasteurized product.
Context / Rationale: Daniel more comfortable noting odor on pasteurized product; note only if noticeable, never mandatory.
Acceptance Criteria: Optional field present; shown on summary.
Notes: PR #48 merged 2026-10-19: optional odour + intensity at the final QC check (Packaging QC Check), shown on the production summary.

Change Request: Presence tracking: show who is logged in and which run/card they are in (initials/icon on the card). Warn when opening a card another user has open.
Context / Rationale: Concurrent edits silently overwrote data ('last save wins'). Version-check/conflict copies deferred as too complex.
Acceptance Criteria: Second user sees warning before editing; presence clears after tab close / timeout.
Notes: Decision 2026-10-19: presence + warning now; a record version check later if conflicts persist. Not built yet.

Change Request: Idle timeout: make configurable via calculations table (global). Decide behavior at timeout: discard unsaved vs. auto-save draft then log out.
Context / Rationale: Current: fixed 12 h session, no idle timeout. Edge cases: tablet dropped in tank 2A, power outage.
Acceptance Criteria: Timeout value editable without deploy; draft recovered after forced logout.
Notes: Decision 2026-10-19: auto-save the draft on idle timeout. Not built yet.

Change Request: Slow/choppy UI and duplicated top bar with two concurrent users (staging).
Context / Rationale: Unclear if Render staging tier or app issue.
Acceptance Criteria: Root cause identified; page load < 2 s with 2 users.

Change Request: Tank selection: 2A, 2B, or both. Dilution water, final fill levels and capacity reflect one or two tanks.
Context / Rationale: Mirror the existing tank 6A/6B pattern (FastField '+' to add a second tank block).
Acceptance Criteria: Both-tank runs capture per-tank levels; single-tank runs unchanged.
Notes: PR #50 open (2026-10-19): tank 2A / 2B / both, required, no default; each tank has its own levels and dilution entries; capacity warning 5,000 L per tank (confirm - QM-001 C13).

Change Request: Solids-loading process check per tank (2A and 2B separately). QC check and sample points stay composite.
Context / Rationale: Tanks can differ (liquid vs. solid totes) so dilution must be calculated per tank.
Acceptance Criteria: Recommended dilution computed per tank; downstream calcs documented.
Notes: PR #50 open (2026-10-19): solids-loading Process Check and recommended dilution per tank; one shared target; QC check and samples stay composite; lot %solids is volume-weighted.

Change Request: Replace SOP list at top of sections with an SOP icon next to each QC check; opens the SOPs assigned to that section.
Context / Rationale: SOP list at top is a distraction; operators still need quick access.
Acceptance Criteria: Icon opens correct SOP list per section.

Change Request: Required sample points (LKE characterization defaults) locked; cannot be removed or have quantity reduced. Optional samples can still be added.
Context / Rationale: Currently user can remove default samples.
Acceptance Criteria: Required samples can't be removed via UI or POST.
Notes: PR #49 merged 2026-10-19: the 4 default LKE samples are locked (cannot be removed, retyped or reduced); optional samples still allowed. QM-001 decision C12.

Change Request: Summary table at bottom of each sample point card: group by container, total quantity (e.g. 7 Falcon tubes, 2 x 1 L bottles).
Context / Rationale: Operator shouldn't do arithmetic before collecting containers.
Acceptance Criteria: Totals match the line items; also on finalize card.

Change Request: 'Bypass extraction' toggle. Default comment 'Extraction not optimized' (editable). When bypassed, extraction required fields are not required to finalize.
Context / Rationale: Product still flows through flow cell, no amplitude/flow rate.
Acceptance Criteria: Bypassed run finalizes; reason shown on summary/release.

Change Request: Keep QC check 'Extraction performance'. When extraction is bypassed, relink its metrics to homogenization-out QC check (slurry characterization card).
Context / Rationale: Decision reversed mid-meeting: card kept. Separation in = homogenization out when bypassed.
Acceptance Criteria: All dependent KPIs compute correctly for bypassed and normal runs.

Change Request: Move the sample point to the very bottom of the separation section (below solids-out and liquid-out QC checks).
Context / Rationale: Sample point can be solid, liquid or slurry, so it belongs after both.
Acceptance Criteria: Sample point renders last in separation.

Change Request: Review mandatory % moisture for centrifuge solids and screw press solids.
Context / Rationale: Neither Nathan nor Daniel sure it should be required.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision: required vs. optional.

Change Request: Auto-populate current TDS in dilution plan from separation liquid-out value.
Context / Rationale: High TDS traced back to separation input during demo.
Acceptance Criteria: Dilution plan pre-fills TDS from separation.

Change Request: Clean up display of potassium sorbate / sodium benzoate added totals (L and kg hard to read; e.g. '40 L (10 kg)').
Acceptance Criteria: Totals readable, consistent units.

Change Request: Default 0 for preservative quantity when none is added (field is required).
Acceptance Criteria: Blank defaults to 0; no zero-quantity inventory entry.

Change Request: 'Dilution pass 2' is functionally another pasteurization pass. Keep name for now, revisit after use.
Acceptance Criteria: Naming decision.

Change Request: Supplier name as dropdown from approved supplier list (no free text).
Context / Rationale: Prevents misspellings. Manufacturer change = new item number.
Acceptance Criteria: Only approved suppliers selectable; legacy values mapped.

Change Request: Consuming a blended tote (BL prefix) in a production run must generate one used 1000 L IBC tote back into packaging inventory.
Context / Rationale: Confirmed during demo: used-tote count did not increase for BL tote.
Acceptance Criteria: BL tote consumption adds +1 used IBC; test passes.
Notes: 2026-10-19: not a bug. A blended (BL) tote consumed in a run returns 1 used IBC when the run is finalized (tested). Pre-processing returns its source IBCs and the pack-out consumes the container chosen - choose Used 1,000 L IBC Tote for a net of zero. No change made.

Change Request: Clean up run summary card (noisy, not centered). KPIs to evolve over time.
Context / Rationale: Shows final TDS, extraction efficiency, conversion rates, QC summary.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved layout; KPIs driven from config.

Change Request: Process conversion ratio: measured tote weight includes added citric acid, skewing it vs. harvest ratio. Review calc basis. 'Rate' vs 'ratio' naming left as-is.
Acceptance Criteria: Calc basis documented; decision on citric correction.

Change Request: Show sample count summary on the end/finalize card (as on the production log report).
Context / Rationale: Check that the correct number of samples was collected.
Acceptance Criteria: Sample totals visible before finalize.

Change Request: Notes front and center in production-log review / product release. Amendment notes did not show on the run card.
Context / Rationale: Notes hold machine failures / process changes; reviewer must see them.
Acceptance Criteria: All notes visible at top of review; amendment notes included.
Notes: PR #47 merged 2026-10-19: all notes (run, feedstock, dilution, amendment reason and the amender's note, sign-off comments) in a panel at the top of the review window and on the run card.

Change Request: Submitted amendment should send the run back into the product-release queue.
Context / Rationale: Nathan: 'the amendment should have put that production run up into there'.
Acceptance Criteria: Amended run reappears in queue; previous sign-off voided.
Notes: PR #47 merged 2026-10-19: Save & close under an amendment asks to submit it; earlier review / release names are no longer shown as current. (Submitting already re-queued the run.)

Change Request: Tailor review/release view to what QA checks before sign-off; remove noise.
Context / Rationale: Default layout was accepted as-is.
Acceptance Criteria: QA-approved field list implemented.

Change Request: Finished-good record shows target TDS instead of actual final TDS. Also add pH to the card.
Context / Rationale: Card showed 1.8 (target) vs 1.90 actual.
Acceptance Criteria: Card shows actual TDS and pH; CoA/label checked.

Change Request: Add intermediate stage: LKE extract intermediate -> finished good (wash, seal, label) before finished label is assigned.
Context / Rationale: Currently run output goes straight to finished goods.
Acceptance Criteria: Finished label only printable after conversion step.

Change Request: Retention sample shelf life default: 12 -> 24 months.
Acceptance Criteria: New samples default to 24 months.

Change Request: Hide 'detailed label number' and 'simplified ID' columns in the samples catalog view.
Acceptance Criteria: Columns hidden by default.

Change Request: Default filter hides status 'Sent to lab'; multi-select status filter to show them on demand.
Context / Rationale: QA still needs a record of what was sent.
Acceptance Criteria: Sent-to-lab hidden by default; selectable.

Change Request: SGS Excel template failed to open. Requisition docx/xlsx auto-download to Downloads; decide target location (production log docs / SharePoint).
Acceptance Criteria: SGS file opens in Excel; files land in run Documents.

Change Request: Multi-run requisitions: define PO naming and ensure lab-report upload maps each result to the correct lot.
Context / Rationale: Risk of results pulled into the wrong lot. Not needed for next week.
Acceptance Criteria: Design approved before multi-run use.

Change Request: Verify 'Other minerals' category mapping in SGS test catalog.
Context / Rationale: Nathan unsure why it appeared.
Acceptance Criteria: Category verified.

Change Request: Add default certified-lab pH, TDS and TSS for every lot. Compare lab vs. internal values; flag variance (possible calibration issue).
Context / Rationale: Cheap (~$20 TDS, ~$5 pH, Nor Labs, per Daniel). Key spec parameters. Cost per lot to confirm.
Acceptance Criteria: Variance auto-calculated and flagged.

Change Request: Select multiple equipment/locations in one SIP event (e.g. pasteurizer + tanks 6A/6B). Single event, single chemical usage.
Acceptance Criteria: One event covers several assets; days-since correct per asset.

Change Request: Maintenance log with interval reminders (e.g. grease tank 2A agitator every 30 days). Evaluate existing CMMS package. Later: runtime-based scheduling from HMI event log.
Acceptance Criteria: Build-vs-buy decision.

Change Request: Calibration log (instrument, buffer checks, date). Links to KW-39 variance flags.
Context / Rationale: Daniel: tighten calibration and buffer-check protocols.
Acceptance Criteria: Readings linked to calibration status.

Change Request: Dark mode ('nerd mode') toggle per user.
Context / Rationale: First request of meeting; re-noted at release step.
Acceptance Criteria: Toggle persists per user; readable contrast.

Change Request: Get expert assessment of mold/VOC exposure from tote surface growth. Gloves for ORP measurements. Replace smell test with ORP. Characterize fermentation end products (ethanol vs. butyric acid) instead of mold ID.
Context / Rationale: Long-term exposure concern; staff illness raised.
Acceptance Criteria: Expert contacted; SOP revised.

Change Request: Evaluate seaweed-carbohydrate lab (Irish lab with NA site, ~11-12 carb types) from Helga's list. Gradually reduce reliance on SGS.
Acceptance Criteria: Lab selected and added to catalog.
